after: Everyone else gets the empty box.
alt: The money followed the people. Google paid a reported $2.7 billion in August 2024 to license Character.AI's technology and hired its founders. Disney has offered jobs to 66 staff at about $60 million a year for three years and made a $20 million opening bid for the technology. Character.AI, in Chapter 11 since 12 October 2026, keeps the app, its users' data and the lawsuits.
